destination.title: Microscopic control and conjectural consistency
destination.question: When are inflationary dynamics and predictions controlled despite ultraviolet operators, additional degrees of freedom, gravitational cutoffs or conjectured quantum-gravity restrictions?
destination.summary: Connects consistency tests and sensitivity calculations while preserving their different hypotheses and systems.

systems: Scalar, gauge-field and tower-based inflationary models
regimes: Finite-field calculations and proposed tower extensions
assumptions: Conjectured bounds apply only conditionally and in their stated settings.
Control of one calculation does not establish a complete ultraviolet realization.
conventions: Field excursions and physical mode wavelengths are different notions of trans-Planckian behavior.
includes: Ordinary EFT questions and source-specific conjecture tests
excludes: Completed curved-background or infinite-tower calculations inferred from a finite Gaussian calculation

evidence.text: Specify a charged wall and two branches, calculate their energy difference at fixed scalar value, and insert tension and energy difference into the cited exponent. Applicability to non-metastable monodromy backgrounds remains unresolved.

sources.title: On the robustness of the primordial power spectrum in renormalized Higgs inflation

evidence.text: Uses the approximate RG-enhanced potential V(φ) = λ(φ)F⁴(φ)/4 with λ(φ) = λ0 + b log²(mt(φ)/q) + δΛ(φ). Numerical scans compare instantaneous thresholds, a loop-truncated field-dependent threshold, and an illustrative collective threshold with independently adjustable amplitude and transition rapidity.
